Class MapState

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.widgets.map.MapState
public final class MapState extends Object
Mutable view state for a map: the current MapViewport.

This is the map counterpart of ListState and TreeState: the stateless map widget renders it, an interactive element's pan and zoom gestures mutate it, and application code (for example a search or a live-data provider) can mutate it to fly to a result and read it to react to panning. Supply one explicitly to keep the viewport across element rebuilds, or let the element create its own.

Mutating methods normalize the bounds: longitude is wrapped into [-180, 180) (a full 360-degree span may rotate, so east can exceed 180), the span is capped at the whole globe, and latitude is clamped to the poles.
